policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Electrical and Electronic Equipment Edition
description: During a thunderstorm a power surge came through the mains and damaged several pieces of the home entertainment setup that were plugged in and running - the TV, the speaker system and the AV receiver. A technician attended, produced a surge-failure report and checked the building wiring. Nothing on that circuit was on a surge-protected strip. One of the mains plugs and its power lead were physically melted by the surge. The claim also lists the HDMI cables and remotes and the wall bracket. A couple of items need flagging. The DVD player had already been playing up for months before the storm and is showing its age, and the router is on the claim but no diagnostic report was produced for it. The technician's invoice carries a return visit, a distribution-board wiring check, an admin fee and a separate call-out line.

lines.4: Melted mains plug and power lead (physically surge- damaged) | 1 flat rate
lines.5: HDMI cables and remote controls 3 pcs
lines.7: DVD player (was already failing before the storm, age- related) | 1 pcs
lines.11: Diagnostic inspection and surge-failure report for damaged electronics | 2 pcs
lines.12: Vehicle costs – return visit 1 flat rate
lines.13: Wiring safety check of property distribution board 1 pcs
lines.14: Administrative and claim-processing fee 1 flat rate
